As a 16-year-old male, sudden onset of lower abdominal pain during physical activity is highly suspicious for testicular torsion, which often presents with referred pain to the groin or abdomen. Given your history of unprotected sex with multiple partners, I must also rule out epididymitis, but the acute nature of the onset during play strongly favors torsion.
